knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The label and the approved procedure set strength and contact time. Speed and surface type do not change that.
Isolation and confirmation of the plan come first. Cleaning and photographs are not the first step.

practicalCriteria: From a fictional job sheet, the learner identifies that the routine scope does not cover a body-fluid spill and writes the hold decision. Pass: the hold decision names the missing plan or assessment.
The learner lists the PPE and waste items the approved plan would specify, without naming any product strength. Pass: no product strength or contact time appears in the list.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed hold decision for a fictional spill
stopWorkCriteria: Body-fluid material is present and no approved plan covers it.
A product is proposed outside its label.
